baseCases.condition: config node is null or undefined
baseCases.result: return [] (empty error list — nothing to validate; caller decides if null is allowed)

baseCases.condition: config node is a primitive leaf (string | number | boolean | null) with no nested keys
baseCases.result: apply type/range/pattern validators to the value; return list of field-level ValidationError objects
return [{ error: 'MAX_DEPTH_EXCEEDED', path: currentPath, depth: currentDepth }] — prevents stack overflow from cyclic or maliciously deep configs

recurrence.formula: validate(node, depth, path) = validateOwnFields(node, path) ++ flatMap(key => validate(node[key], depth + 1, path + '.' + key), keys(node.subConfigs))
recurrence.closedForm: O(n) — each config node is visited exactly once
recurrence.timeComplexity: O(n) where n = total number of config nodes across all nesting levels
recurrence.spaceComplexity: O(d) where d = maximum nesting depth (implicit call stack); O(n + d) if error accumulation is included

subproblems.description: Validate each direct child key of the current config object using the same rule set — required fields, forbidden fields, type constraints, enum constraints, cross-field dependencies
subproblems.size: subtree rooted at child node (strictly fewer nodes than parent subtree)

subproblems.description: For array-valued config fields (e.g. 'servers: [...]'), validate each array element as an independent sub-config using the same recursive validator
subproblems.size: subtree rooted at each array element (bounded by array length × element depth)

subproblems.description: For schema-referenced sub-configs ($ref or 'extends'), inline-expand the reference and validate the merged config — same rule set, smaller or equal subtree
subproblems.size: merged config node count (no larger than source + override nodes)

haltingCondition.parameter: subtree node count N(node) = 1 + sum(N(child) for child in node.subConfigs)
haltingCondition.strictlyDecreases: Each recursive call is on node[key], whose subtree is a strict subset of the parent's subtree. No child subtree equals the parent. N(node[key]) < N(node) for all keys.
haltingCondition.guard: bc3 (maxDepth = 32) provides a hard ceiling independent of subtree counting — handles cycles if the config graph is a DAG with back-edges due to $ref resolution

memoization.note: Disabled for pure tree configs (each node is visited exactly once, no overlap). Enable with a path-keyed cache ONLY when $ref expansion causes the same schema fragment to be validated multiple times — e.g. a shared 'address' sub-schema referenced by both 'billingAddress' and 'shippingAddress'.
